chapter: Heroes, heard bands and Lunceford's life on the road
title: The best drum soloists: Chick Webb, Catlett and Jo Jones
summary: Crawford says Chick Webb outdid them all, including Buddy Rich, and speaks of his fast foot.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Who were the -- who were the best -- in your opinion, who were the drummers that played the best solos that you ever --

Chick Webb -- Chick Webb, Big Sid and Jo Jones played a good solo and breaks. But Chick Webb passes like -- yeah, that little guy could play. Big Sid was tasty. That was my idea. But Chick Webb outdid them all,
including Buddy Rich, all of them. Chick Webb. I don't know whether you ever heard him.
Yeah, I've heard him play on record.
Yeah, but that man, he had some --
Is it true that he could play a roll on his bass drum?
Maybe so. I wouldn't put nothing above him.
But I never heard him. Maybe I did hear him, but I've forgotten really. Oh, he was fast. He could practically play a roll on his bass drum with his foot. Yeah, he was fast. That's all I could say.
